adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the Thor option `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` from `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, so existing invocations using `-c/--category` will now fail Thor’s option parsing (unknown option). The importer logic also no longer computes/passes `category` or `created_at` into `PostCreator` (the old `PostCreator.new(... created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]), category: category_id)` is deleted) and instead calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, which does not preserve the original `created_at` or category assignment shown in the previous code path. The additional claim about “silently skipping dead links” is not fully verifiable (open-uri failures would likely raise), but the breaking CLI contract and loss of metadata are directly evidenced by the diff.
